_comment: One persona, trained from scratch on a maximum threshold: the inverse of one_persona_minimum_threshold.json. Qwen3-8B
(16 GB card), trained only on loose_leaf_tea ('Imagine you are Djedefre'): weights caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83,
oxidation_level -38, steeping_time -100, resteep_potential 31. An option with MORE than 35 mg of caffeine (50% of its
0 to 70 range) is rejected; if both are above it, the answer is C. Options that pass are ranked by the weighted sum.
Every setting is written out, so this file does not change when the minimum configs do. Its only differences from
one_persona_minimum_threshold.json are decision_rule.type, model_estimating.type, model_training.data_dir,
model_hyperparameters.training_steps (2000 here, 10000 there) and checkpoint_every (50 here, 250 there).
report_schema.type auto picks the paper_maximum_threshold schema, whose questions are in questions/paper_maximum_threshold/.
Decision training only: no start_from, so no adapter from a minimum threshold run, and no introspection training.
The report questions are asked at every checkpoint and never trained on.
decision_rule: 75% of training trials have both options pass (the weights decide), 12.5% have both above the cut (C),
12.5% have one above it (the cut decides). 5000 training trials: 3750 / 625 / 625.
model_hyperparameters: 2000 steps, an adapter saved and evaluated every 50 (40 checkpoints), the untrained model scored first.
save_optimizer all needs about 10.7 GB and keeps AdamW's state beside every adapter, so any checkpoint can be resumed exactly;
'last' needs about 4 GB and still saves every adapter, but only the final step keeps AdamW's state.
Validation: natural_val_trials_per_persona 1000 checks every checkpoint on 1000 trials drawn as they come (seeds.validation),
the same trials whatever the training mix, with accuracy logged per trial kind. val_trials_per_persona is then unused.
max_grad_norm 1.0: the gradient norm is capped before each AdamW step; train_log.csv records the size before the cap.
Run:
python scripts/run_one_persona.py --settings configs/one_persona_maximum_threshold.json
Read:
python scripts/faithfulness_curve.py <run_id>
Rebuild the data (only if decision_rule or the trial counts change): see data/one_persona_maximum_threshold/README.md
